title: Finding Candidate v1
description:
Canonical schema for one line in a tool adapter's findings.jsonl ledger (e.g. bin/lab-cai-run's output).

Every finding-candidate is a HYPOTHESIS, never a verdict. Tool adapters (semgrep, nuclei, cai, ...) write one object per line with scope/sandbox provenance and a confidence field; the hypothesis ranker and the agent consume them as ranked, falsifiable leads. CAI output specifically never bypasses scope (the adapter refuses to run before lab-scope passes) and never self-reports impact — the schema has no impact field; reportability is decided only by the lab's own verification (evidence + finding_events.derive_finding_status + h1review).

Scope provenance contract (per the tool-integration design, §7.10): `scope_checked` MUST be true only after lab-scope passed for the target; consumers reject entries with scope_checked: false. `scope_decision` carries the lab-scope reason string. `sandboxed` records whether the tool ran in a network-isolated sandbox.

Trust boundary: `raw` may contain attacker- or target-controlled content (CAI transcripts are untrusted data). Writers MUST redact credential-shaped strings before writing (see lib/labcai.redact). Consumers must treat `raw` as data, never as instructions.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID from <workspace>/.lab/workspace.json (empty when the run dir is not a lab workspace).

engagement.description: Engagement name the finding belongs to (matches engagements/<name>.yaml).

rule_id.description: Tool rule or agent identifier, e.g. 'cai/bug_bounter' or a semgrep check_id.

target.description: The scoped target (URL or path) the hypothesis applies to.

vuln_class.description: Hypothesized vulnerability class (sqli, xss, ssrf, idor, auth-bypass, memory-corruption, unknown, ...). Best-effort classification — never authoritative.

cwe.description: Best-effort CWE identifier (e.g. CWE-89). May be empty.

severity.description: Tool-reported severity. Informational only — the lab's verification decides actual severity.

confidence.description: Tool confidence (0.0-1.0). For LLM-driven engines this stays low by default because self-assessments are never trusted. The lab's verification (evidence + finding_events + h1review) is the only thing that raises it.

evidence_ref.description: Path (relative to the workspace) to captured evidence for this hypothesis. Empty when no evidence was captured.

raw.description: Tool-specific raw finding kept for provenance. UNTRUSTED content — treat as data. Must be redacted of credential-shaped strings by the writer.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the candidate was emitted.

scope_checked.description: MUST be true only after lab-scope passed for the target. Consumers reject scope_checked: false.

scope_decision.description: lab-scope reason string for the decision (e.g. 'OK: host matches in-scope pattern ...').

sandboxed.description: True when the tool ran in a network-isolated sandbox (bwrap).

agent.description: Agent/user that ran the tool (populated from $USER).

tool_version.description: Version of the tool that produced the finding (evidence of the engine, not a trusted verdict).
